core.exposure:exposure.name: Exposure
core.exposure:exposure.description: Brightens or darkens the image in exposure stops. Increase to lift the whole image; decrease to darken it. 0 EV leaves the image unchanged.

core.local-exposure:exposure.name: Exposure
core.local-exposure:exposure.description: Brightens or darkens the masked area in exposure stops. Increase to lift it; decrease to darken it. 0 EV leaves the image unchanged.

core.blur:radius.name: Blur Radius
core.blur:radius.description: Controls how far the blur reaches from each pixel. Larger radii soften broader structures; smaller radii soften fine detail. Very large radii can erase local contrast.

core.levels:black_point.name: Black Point
core.levels:black_point.description: Sets the input level mapped to black. Raise it to deepen shadows, but values set too high can crush shadow detail.

core.levels:white_point.name: White Point
core.levels:white_point.description: Sets the input level mapped to white. Lower it to brighten highlights, but values set too low can clip detail.

core.curves:gamma.name: Midtone Gamma
core.curves:gamma.description: Shapes the transfer curve. Higher values brighten midtones; lower values darken them. 1 is the neutral diagonal.

core.levels:gamma.name: Midtone Gamma
core.levels:gamma.description: Adjusts the brightness of midtones between the black and white points. Higher values brighten midtones; lower values darken them without moving the endpoints.

core.crop:x.name: Left Edge
core.crop:x.description: Sets the crop’s horizontal starting position in the image.

core.crop:y.name: Top Edge
core.crop:y.description: Sets the crop’s vertical starting position in the image.

core.crop:width.name: Crop Width
core.crop:width.description: Sets the width of the cropped area.

core.crop:height.name: Crop Height
core.crop:height.description: Sets the height of the cropped area.

core.resize:width.name: Output Width
core.resize:width.description: Sets the resized image width. The image proportions are not constrained by this value.

core.resize:height.name: Output Height
core.resize:height.description: Sets the resized image height. The image proportions are not constrained by this value.

raw.white-balance:red_gain.name: Red Balance
raw.white-balance:red_gain.description: Fine-tunes the red channel gain used for RAW white balance. Increase to add red; reduce to add its complementary cyan cast.

raw.white-balance:green_gain.name: Green Balance
raw.white-balance:green_gain.description: Fine-tunes the green channel gain used for RAW white balance. Increase to add green; reduce to add its complementary magenta cast.

raw.white-balance:blue_gain.name: Blue Balance
raw.white-balance:blue_gain.description: Fine-tunes the blue channel gain used for RAW white balance. Increase to add blue; reduce to add its complementary yellow cast.

raw.highlight-reconstruction:threshold.name: Highlight Recovery Threshold
raw.highlight-reconstruction:threshold.description: Sets how close a RAW channel must be to clipping before reconstruction begins. Lower values recover more highlight detail but can affect bright tones that were not clipped.

raw.highlight-reconstruction:strength.name: Recovery Strength
raw.highlight-reconstruction:strength.description: Controls how strongly clipped RAW highlights are rebuilt from neighboring color information. Higher values recover more color detail but may create false color or uneven tones.

raw.camera-transform:working_space.name: Working Color Space
raw.camera-transform:working_space.description: Determines the color space used for downstream processing. Choose a wider gamut when later operations need to preserve saturated colors.

pro.denoise:strength.name: Noise Reduction Strength
pro.denoise:strength.description: Reduces visible image noise. Increase for smoother shadows; too much removes fine texture and can make details look waxy.

pro.advanced-denoise:strength.name: Noise Reduction Strength
pro.advanced-denoise:strength.description: Reduces visible image noise. Increase for smoother shadows; too much removes fine texture and can make details look waxy.

pro.denoise:radius.name: Noise Sampling Radius
pro.denoise:radius.description: Sets the neighborhood used to identify noise. Larger radii detect broader noise patterns but can smooth fine texture.

pro.advanced-denoise:radius.name: Noise Sampling Radius
pro.advanced-denoise:radius.description: Sets the neighborhood used to identify noise. Larger radii detect broader noise patterns but can smooth fine texture.

pro.denoise:preserve_detail.name: Fine Detail Protection
pro.denoise:preserve_detail.description: Preserves fine texture while reducing noise. Increase to retain more detail; noise reduction may become less aggressive.

pro.advanced-denoise:preserve_detail.name: Fine Detail Protection
pro.advanced-denoise:preserve_detail.description: Preserves fine texture while reducing noise. Increase to retain more detail; noise reduction may become less aggressive.

pro.sharpen:radius.name: Sharpening Radius
pro.sharpen:radius.description: Sets the width of edges affected by sharpening. Smaller radii emphasize fine detail; larger radii affect broader edges and can create halos.

pro.advanced-sharpen:radius.name: Sharpening Radius
pro.advanced-sharpen:radius.description: Sets the width of edges affected by sharpening. Smaller radii emphasize fine detail; larger radii affect broader edges and can create halos.

pro.sharpen:amount.name: Sharpening Strength
pro.sharpen:amount.description: Increases local contrast along edges. Raise it for crisper detail; excessive strength creates bright or dark halos.

pro.advanced-sharpen:amount.name: Sharpening Strength
pro.advanced-sharpen:amount.description: Increases local contrast along edges. Raise it for crisper detail; excessive strength creates bright or dark halos.

pro.sharpen:threshold.name: Edge Threshold
pro.sharpen:threshold.description: Controls how different neighboring pixels must be before sharpening treats them as an edge. Lower values sharpen finer detail and noise; higher values protect smooth areas.

pro.advanced-sharpen:threshold.name: Edge Threshold
pro.advanced-sharpen:threshold.description: Controls how different neighboring pixels must be before sharpening treats them as an edge. Lower values sharpen finer detail and noise; higher values protect smooth areas.

pro.deconvolution:radius.name: Blur Correction Radius
pro.deconvolution:radius.description: Approximate radius of the blur being corrected. Increase for wider optical or motion blur; values that are too high can create halos and ringing.

pro.deconvolution:amount.name: Correction Strength
pro.deconvolution:amount.description: Controls how strongly blur is reversed. Increase for clearer detail; excessive strength creates ringing and amplifies noise.

pro.deconvolution:threshold.name: Noise Protection Threshold
pro.deconvolution:threshold.description: Protects low-contrast areas from deconvolution. Increase to reduce noise amplification; too high can leave soft detail untouched.

pro.deconvolution:iterations.name: Processing Passes
pro.deconvolution:iterations.description: Sets how many times the blur correction is refined. More passes can recover detail but take longer and may increase ringing or noise.

pro.local-contrast:radius.name: Local Contrast Scale
pro.local-contrast:radius.description: Sets the size of image structures whose contrast is adjusted. Smaller values affect fine texture; larger values affect broader shapes.

pro.texture:radius.name: Texture Scale
pro.texture:radius.description: Sets the size of image structures affected. Smaller values target fine texture; larger values affect broader detail.

pro.local-contrast:amount.name: Local Contrast
pro.local-contrast:amount.description: Adjusts contrast around nearby details. Positive values add definition; negative values soften local transitions. Strong settings can create halos.

pro.texture:amount.name: Texture Strength
pro.texture:amount.description: Adjusts contrast in texture at the selected scale. Positive values emphasize texture; negative values soften it.

pro.tone-map:exposure.name: Exposure
pro.tone-map:exposure.description: Adjusts overall brightness before tone mapping. Positive values brighten; negative values darken.

pro.advanced-tone-map:exposure.name: Exposure
pro.advanced-tone-map:exposure.description: Adjusts overall brightness before tone mapping. Positive values brighten; negative values darken.

pro.tone-map:operator.name: Tone Mapping Method
pro.tone-map:operator.description: Chooses how scene highlights are compressed for display. Different methods trade highlight detail, contrast, and natural-looking roll-off.

pro.advanced-tone-map:operator.name: Tone Mapping Method
pro.advanced-tone-map:operator.description: Chooses how scene highlights are compressed for display. Different methods trade highlight detail, contrast, and natural-looking roll-off.

pro.color-zones:hue.name: Target Hue
pro.color-zones:hue.description: Selects the center hue of the color range to adjust. Move around the color wheel to target a different hue.

pro.color-zones:width.name: Hue Range Width
pro.color-zones:width.description: Sets the hue-distance radius on either side of Target Hue. The affected arc spans twice this value and wraps across 0°/360°; adjustment strength fades toward its edges.

pro.split-toning:shadow_hue.name: Shadow Hue
pro.split-toning:shadow_hue.description: Sets the color tint added to shadows. Adjust saturation separately to control how visible the tint is.

pro.split-toning:highlight_hue.name: Highlight Hue
pro.split-toning:highlight_hue.description: Sets the color tint added to highlights. Adjust saturation separately to control how visible the tint is.

pro.split-toning:shadow_saturation.name: Shadow Saturation
pro.split-toning:shadow_saturation.description: Controls the strength of the shadow tint. 0% applies no tint.

pro.split-toning:highlight_saturation.name: Highlight Saturation
pro.split-toning:highlight_saturation.description: Controls the strength of the highlight tint. 0% applies no tint.

pro.split-toning:balance.name: Shadow–Highlight Balance
pro.split-toning:balance.description: Moves the tonal boundary between shadow and highlight tinting. Shift toward highlights or shadows to change which tones receive each color.

ai.strength.name: Generation Strength
ai.strength.description: Controls how strongly the generated result can change the input image. Lower values preserve more of the original; higher values allow greater change.

ai.steps.name: Generation Steps
ai.steps.description: Sets how many refinement steps the image generator performs. More steps may improve consistency but increase processing time; results depend on the provider and model.

ai.seed.name: Random Seed
ai.seed.description: Sets the random starting point for generation. Reusing a seed with the same model and settings helps reproduce a result; 0 may request a provider-selected seed.

ai.upscale:scale.name: Upscale Factor
ai.upscale:scale.description: Sets the output size relative to the input. Higher factors create a larger image and require more processing.

core.compare:operation.name: Comparison
core.compare:operation.description: Chooses how the two values are compared.

core.mask-painted:mode.name: Brush Mode
core.mask-painted:mode.description: Adds the painted stroke to the mask or subtracts it from the existing mask.

pro.grain:amount.name: Grain Strength
pro.grain:amount.description: Controls how visible the simulated film grain is. Increase for a stronger texture; high values can obscure fine image detail.

pro.grain:size.name: Grain Size
pro.grain:size.description: Sets the scale of the simulated grain. Smaller grain is finer; larger grain is coarser and more visible.

pro.grain:monochrome.name: Monochrome Grain
pro.grain:monochrome.description: Uses neutral grain instead of adding colored grain variation.

pro.halation:amount.name: Halation Strength
pro.halation:amount.description: Controls the red-orange glow around bright areas. Increase for a stronger film-like bloom; high values can wash out nearby detail.

pro.bloom:amount.name: Bloom Strength
pro.bloom:amount.description: Controls the glow spreading from bright areas. Increase for a stronger soft glow; high values can reduce contrast and obscure detail.

pro.halation:threshold.name: Highlight Threshold
pro.halation:threshold.description: Sets how bright a pixel must be before it contributes to the glow. Lower values include more of the image; higher values restrict the effect to brighter highlights.

pro.bloom:threshold.name: Highlight Threshold
pro.bloom:threshold.description: Sets how bright a pixel must be before it contributes to the glow. Lower values include more of the image; higher values restrict the effect to brighter highlights.

pro.halation:radius.name: Glow Radius
pro.halation:radius.description: Sets how far the highlight glow spreads. Larger radii create a broader, softer halo.

pro.bloom:radius.name: Glow Radius
pro.bloom:radius.description: Sets how far the highlight glow spreads. Larger radii create a broader, softer halo.

pro.vignetting:amount.name: Vignette Strength
pro.vignetting:amount.description: Darkens or brightens the image corners relative to the center. Increase for stronger darkening; negative values can lighten the corners.

pro.vignetting:midpoint.name: Vignette Midpoint
pro.vignetting:midpoint.description: Sets how far the vignette extends toward the center. Lower values bring the effect inward; higher values keep it near the corners.

pro.vignetting:feather.name: Vignette Feather
pro.vignetting:feather.description: Controls how gradually the vignette fades into the unaffected area. Higher values create a softer transition.

pro.defringe:threshold.name: Fringe Detection Threshold
pro.defringe:threshold.description: Sets how strong a colored edge must be before it is corrected. Lower values also affect subtler color edges; higher values leave more fringe untouched.

pro.defringe:amount.name: Fringe Correction Strength
pro.defringe:amount.description: Controls how strongly colored fringes are reduced. Increase to remove more fringe; excessive correction can remove legitimate color along edges.

core.mask-threshold:threshold.name: Mask Luminance Threshold
core.mask-threshold:threshold.description: Sets the luminance level separating selected and unselected mask areas. Lower values include darker regions; higher values select only brighter regions.

core.mask-threshold:softness.name: Mask Edge Softness
core.mask-threshold:softness.description: Softens the transition around the mask threshold. Increase for a gradual selection edge; decrease for a sharper boundary.

core.mask-color-qualifier:tolerance.name: Color Range Width
core.mask-color-qualifier:tolerance.description: Controls how far colors may differ from the target and still be selected. Increase to include a wider range of colors.

core.mask-color-qualifier:softness.name: Selection Edge Softness
core.mask-color-qualifier:softness.description: Softens the boundary of the color selection. Increase for a smoother transition; decrease for a more exact edge.

core.hdr-merge:highlight_threshold.name: Highlight Merge Threshold
core.hdr-merge:highlight_threshold.description: Controls when highlight detail is taken from another exposure in the set. Lower values bring in replacement detail sooner.

core.hdr-merge:deghost_threshold.name: Motion Ghosting Tolerance
core.hdr-merge:deghost_threshold.description: Controls how much movement between exposures can be blended. Lower values reject more moving areas; higher values blend more but may leave ghosting.

core.focus-stack:blend_floor.name: Minimum Blend Weight
core.focus-stack:blend_floor.description: Sets the minimum contribution retained from each frame during focus stacking. Higher values can reduce abrupt transitions but may soften out-of-focus areas.

commonDescriptions.radius: Sets the spatial reach around each pixel. Smaller values affect fine detail; larger values affect broader structures. Very large values can soften or alter more of the image than intended.
commonDescriptions.threshold: Sets the point at which this operation begins affecting image values. Lower thresholds include more subtle detail; higher thresholds leave more of the image untouched.
commonDescriptions.amount: Controls the strength of this image adjustment. Increase to make the effect more pronounced; decrease for a subtler result. Strong settings can introduce artifacts.
commonDescriptions.iterations: Sets the number of processing passes. More passes can refine the result but take longer and may increase artifacts.
commonDescriptions.seed: Sets the random starting point. Reusing a seed with the same settings helps reproduce a result; 0 may select a seed automatically.
commonDescriptions.tolerance: Controls how closely colors or values must match to be included. Lower values select a narrower range; higher values include more variation.
commonDescriptions.softness: Softens the transition around this effect. Increase for a gradual blend; decrease for a sharper boundary.
commonDescriptions.hardness: Controls how sharply the effect fades at its edge. Higher values create a crisper boundary; lower values create a softer transition.
commonDescriptions.feather: Softens the boundary of the affected area. Increase for a more gradual transition; decrease for a sharper edge.
commonDescriptions.points: Defines the curve used to remap input values to output values. Moving points changes tonal response; the straight diagonal is neutral.
